description: Generate an image from a text prompt using AI. Providers: openai (DALL-E), xai (Aurora), google (Imagen), bfl (FLUX). Available: none configured

outputDirectory.description: Directory to save the generated file. Supports absolute or relative paths (resolved from cwd). Defaults to MEDIA_OUTPUT_DIR env var or cwd.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate

provider.description: Provider to use: openai, xai, google, bfl. Auto-selects if omitted.

name: generate_image
